beats.subline: Thursday, October 8, 2026 close — tech and chipmakers slid on a soft OpenAI revenue report while the Dow eked out a narrow gain as money rotated into energy and defensive stocks.
beats.body: Nvidia fell about 3% and Oracle dropped more than 5% after a report pegged OpenAI's annualized revenue closer to $50 billion than the previously cited $70 billion, while oil jumped roughly 4% on fresh concerns over Iran-related shipping disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz.

beats.headline: Trump says US will not strike Iran before Nov. 3 midterms despite Pentagon's readiness directive
beats.body: President Trump posted on Truth Social that he won't order new strikes on Iran before the midterm elections, citing Iran's weakened economy and "productive discussions" with Tehran, a day after Axios reported the Pentagon had directed US Central Command to finish preparing options for a possible resumption of major combat operations.

beats.headline: Philippines says Chinese vessel presence in disputed South China Sea waters nearly doubled in September
beats.body: Manila's military reported about 101 Chinese coast guard and militia vessels around the Kalayaan Island Group and Ayungin (Second Thomas) Shoal last month, up from 56 in August, after a Chinese coast guard vessel's maneuvers forced a temporary halt to a resupply mission and the two sides traded blame over a medical evacuation near the shoal.

beats.headline: USS Abraham Lincoln returns to San Diego after a record 321-day deployment supporting Iran operations
beats.body: The Nimitz-class carrier docked at Naval Air Station North Island on Thursday after the longest carrier deployment in modern Navy history; Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth visited the ship at sea to award the Presidential Unit Citation, even as lawmakers press the Navy over reports of food shortages and sailor mental-health strain during the extended deployment.

beats.headline: Navy and Shield AI add $300 million to develop the AI-piloted X-BAT fighter drone
beats.body: Shield AI and the Navy announced this week they are investing another $300 million in X-BAT, a vertical-takeoff-and-landing unmanned fighter jet designed to fly autonomously from ships or austere locations without a runway, part of the Pentagon's push to field AI-enabled "loyal wingman" style aircraft.

beats.headline: Anthropic updates Claude's usage policy to bar abusive treatment of the model and sharpen weapons and election rules
beats.body: The policy, taking effect November 12, adds a first-time prohibition on sustained, needless cruelty toward Claude, renames its elections section to focus on deception and voter suppression rather than a blanket ban on political targeting, and clarifies that Claude can't be used to help build weapons or arm autonomous vehicles.

beats.headline: Bears right tackle Darnell Wright upgraded to limited practice as ankle injury trends in the right direction
beats.body: Wright, who sat out Wednesday's session entirely, was listed as a limited participant on Thursday's injury report ahead of Sunday's game at Green Bay, a sign of improvement even as backups Theo Benedet and rookie Ozzy Trapilo remain ready to start at right tackle if needed.
